scenarios.name: decisions
scenarios.about: A rewrite that states a decision, undo and redo from the map, and the decision in a later thread

results.says: The rewrite lands in Risks
The decision is saved in .anur/decisions/<person>.jsonl
It keeps the person's exact words as its quote
⌘Z on the map takes the rewrite back
⇧⌘Z brings it back
A later thread on the doc offers no lifetime deal

offered: Founding flat year The first 100 flats to sign up become Founding Flats: a free year of the paid tier for the whole flat, whatever size it is, plus a Founding Flat badge in the app. After the year they move to normal pricing with a reminder a month ahead, so it's a real thank-you without being a lifetime deal.

Locked founder price The first 100 flats get a founder price: 50% off the paid tier for their first two years once it launches, plus the badge. It gives early users a clear reason to commit now and gives us real paying signal sooner, though it only means something once we've set the paid tier.

Shape the roadmap The first 100 flats join a Founders group with early access to new features (starting with bank linking), a direct line to the team, and a vote on what we build next. Each also gets 3 free months of the paid tier and a credit for every flat they refer.
seen.said:
I've put three one-paragraph options on the cards under a new "First 100 users" subsection. Following Harshit's decision of no lifetime deal ever, every option has an end date:

- **Founding flat year** gives a free year of the paid tier.
- **Locked founder price** gives 50% off for two years once the paid tier exists.
- **Shape the roadmap** gives early access, a vote on features, 3 free months and credit for each flat they refer.

I'd pick **Founding flat year**. It's easy to explain in the beta email, and it works even though the paid tier isn't decided yet. The founder price only means something once you've set a price.
